title: Gift Draw event file
description: One event to create in Gift Draw (Lootjes trekken): its settings, its groups and their participants. Importing always creates a new event. The file holds no pairs and no links; the app makes those on import. Importing sends no email. Lengths are counted as the app's form fields count them, in UTF-16 code units: most emoji count as two characters, so text full of emoji can be refused below a maxLength given here.

name.description: The event's name, for the organiser, such as "Christmas 2026".

language.description: The language participants start in: nl (Dutch) or en (English). Each participant can switch.

cleanupWeeks.description: Weeks after a group's exchange date after which that group and all its data are erased.

theme.description: The text participants read at the top of their page, such as the rules of the exchange. Line breaks are kept. Leave it out for the app's standard text.

wishOptions.description: The choices participants can tick under "I like...", in order. Leave it out for the standard list. A label that matches a standard choice (such as Thee/Tea) is shown translated in each participant's language; other labels are shown as written.

sections.description: The parts of the wish form participants fill in. Every part is shown with its usual heading unless set otherwise here. Leave out any part you do not change.

avoid.description: Rather not, such as allergies (free text).

petOptions.description: The choices under "Pets", in order. Leave it out for the standard list (dog, cat, other).

groups.description: The groups, such as one per class. Each group draws names among its own participants only.

name.description: The group's name, such as "Monday morning".

exchangeDate.description: The day the presents are exchanged, as YYYY-MM-DD. It cannot be in the past.

exchangeTime.description: Optional time of the exchange, 24-hour, such as 10:30.

exchangePlace.description: Optional place of the exchange, on one line, such as "Studio De Lotus, Dorpsstraat 1".

autoOpenAt.description: Optional day drawing opens by itself, as YYYY-MM-DD: not in the past and not after exchangeDate. It only happens once the organiser has sent the invitations.

participants.description: The people in this group. A group needs at least 3 people before pairs are made. Leave it empty to add people later.

name.description: The person's name as the group knows them. Make names in one group differ.

email.description: Optional email address, with a dot in the domain and only plain letters, digits and .!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~- before the @. Without one, the organiser shares the person's link or prints a card.

oneOf.description: A choice. Text after a question mark is a question shown once the choice is ticked, as in "Books? Which author?"; a question mark alone, as in "Wine?", asks a general question.

label.description: The choice as participants see it. A question mark in it is dropped.

question.description: A question shown in a text field under the choice once it is ticked, such as "Which author?". Shown as written in every language.

askDetails.description: true gives the choice a text field with a general question, when there is no question of your own.

show.description: false hides this part of the form.

heading.description: A heading of your own, shown as written in every language. Leave it out for the usual heading in each participant's language.
